# GoldRatesToday.in

> India's premium destination for live gold, silver and bullion prices with calculators and city-wise rates.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Live gold and silver prices with city explorer and tools.
- [Live Prices](/prices): 24K, 22K, 18K gold and silver rates per gram in INR, updated every minute.
- [Gold Calculator](/calculator): Calculate jewellery price with live rate, making charge and GST.

## Cities
- [Mumbai](/city/mumbai): Live gold rate in Mumbai.
- [Delhi](/city/delhi): Live gold rate in Delhi.
- [Bangalore](/city/bangalore): Live gold rate in Bangalore.
- [Chennai](/city/chennai): Live gold rate in Chennai.
